title: Exponential bound for machine codes
statement:
Let $N$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, with $k$ work tapes and finite state set $Q$. Set $K=2\bigl(\lvert\mathrm{Option}(Q)\times\{0,1,2\}\rvert+3k+1\bigr)+2$, where $\lvert\cdot\rvert$ denotes cardinality. For every $c,n\in\mathbb{N}$, if $b(n)$ is the length of the binary expansion of $n$ and $\ell(n)=\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1$ for $n>0$, with $\ell(0)=1$, then
\[
2^{K\left(c(b(n)+1)+\ell(n)+1\right)}\leq 8^{K(c+1)}(n+1)^{K(c+1)}.
\]
